description: Contains utility functions for copying text to the clipboard, including a fallback implementation for older browsers.

methods.name: fallbackCopyTextToClipboard
methods.description: Uses a textarea element to copy text to the clipboard as a fallback for browsers that do not support the navigator.clipboard API.

methods.name: copyTextToClipboard
methods.description: Attempts to copy text to the clipboard using the modern navigator.clipboard API; falls back to fallbackCopyTextToClipboard if unavailable.
